subject.title: Feature request: per-pattern session maintenance retention rules

question: Should OpenClaw add a public session.maintenance retention-rule matcher, and what typed matcher plus protection ordering should it use?
rationale: The request adds a public config surface for destructive session retention, and the code already has several protected/synthetic special cases that need a single maintainer-approved contract before implementation.

options.title: Approve typed retention rules
options.body: Define a structured matcher over session kind/channel/metadata with first-match age retention, documented fallbacks, and explicit protection precedence before implementation.

options.title: Keep narrow fixed policies
options.body: Continue solving only proven high-pressure session classes such as model-run probes with fixed internal cleanup and leave generic rules out of config for now.

options.title: Fold into narrower issues
options.body: Defer this broader issue and resolve only per-label keep-N and preserveKeys through their own open design threads.

recommendation.title: Approve typed retention rules
recommendation.body: Define a structured matcher over session kind/channel/metadata with first-match age retention, documented fallbacks, and explicit protection precedence before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent session-maintenance fixes and product/config compatibility decisions point to steipete as the best available routing owner for the public retention contract choice.
